description: This file defines a debug view class for inspecting the contents and metrics of a generic cache, specifically a ConcurrentLruCache, within the Orleans.Caching.Internal namespace.

classes.name: CacheDebugView<K, V>
classes.description: A debug view class for inspecting cache items and metrics in a ConcurrentLruCache.

methods.name: CacheDebugView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the debug view with a specific cache instance.

methods.name: Items
methods.description: Property that returns all cache items as an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: Metrics
methods.description: Property that exposes cache metrics if available.
